# Dimensions

One rem ladder that every gap, size, radius and stroke reads from. Heights land on a multiple of 4 px (025).

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/Dimensions.mdx`

## Overview

Dimension is the ruler. Spacing, sizing, radius and stroke are what you measure with it, the way color roles read from the palette. Every length on a page is a dimension primitive, or is computed from them (a column width, a fill).

| Use | Measures | Page |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sizing | How big a thing is: control, row, label, media, field | Dimensions |
| Spacing | Empty space: pad, stack, inline, gutter | Spacing |
| Layout | Where boxes go: columns, breakpoints, content widths | Grid |
| Radius · Stroke | Corners and lines | Radius · Border |

In Figma the ladder is the hidden `spacing / primitives` collection; nothing binds a primitive directly. Bind the semantic, template or component token that names the job.

## Primitives

Primitives are named in basis points of a rem: `100` is 1 rem, 16 px at the default root; `025` is 0.25 rem, 4 px. The quarter primitives below step by 4 px (`025`). Above 80, the size ladder continues for widths: 120 · 160 · 224 · 240 · 304 · 320 · 400 · 480 · 640 · 720 · 864 · 1232.

### Fine primitives

Below `100`, four values are not a multiple of 4 px (`025`): 1, 2, 6 and 10. They live inside components only: a stroke, a radius, a focus offset, an icon gap, or the pad-y that lands a control’s height on the grid. Templates read quarter primitives only.

| Primitive | px | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `00625` | 1 | stroke-1 |
| `0125` | 2 | stroke-2, focus ring, pad-y-sm |
| `0375` | 6 | pad-y-md, radius-control-sm, tag gap |
| `0625` | 10 | radius-control-lg |

## Heights snap to 4 px (025)

Every line-height, control, row, label and fixed-height box is a multiple of 4 px (025 rem). A box that hugs its content stays on the grid because its lines and pads are on it. The line box snaps, not the glyph: 14 px text sits in a 20 line. Sizes are rem, so a reader who sets a larger default font gets a larger grid, and everything still lands on it.

| Measured | Values |
| --- | --- |
| Line-heights | 16 · 20 · 24 · 28 · 32 · 36 |
| Controls | `size-150 · size-200 · size-250 · size-300` |
| Rows | `size-200 · size-250 · size-300` |
| Labels | `size-100 · size-125` |
| Media | 16 · 20 · 24 · 32 · 40 · 48 · 96 · 128 |

## Core sizes

Five box sizes, every `050` from `100` to `300`: 16 · 24 · 32 · 40 · 48. Reach for these first; any other multiple of 025 is still allowed. An empty cell is a rule: no control below the 24 target, no row under 32.

## Size roles

Pick the role, then its size; the pixel leads and the token is the binding. Icon sizes (12 · 16 plain; 24 inside Tile 40–48 and Avatar) live on Iconography; frame sizes on Grid; template sizes on Spacing.

| Role | Sizes | Tokens | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Button | compact 24 · default 32 · spacious 48 | `--control-sm · -md · -xl` | Spacious only in a footer |
| Field (text, search, select) | compact 32 · default 40 | `--control-md · -lg` | One family: search and select take the field sizes |
| Row | compact 32 · default 40 · spacious 48 | `--row-height-sm · -md · -lg` | A minimum; rows grow with content |
| Tag | `size-125` | `--label-height-md` | One size: read-only, removable, or in a field |
| Count · Change | `size-100` | `--label-height-sm` | A number, beside or inside a label; one size |
| Status · Date · Competency | 20 · spacious 32 | `--label-height-md · --control-md` | Spacious beside a page, panel or module title |
| Label max width | 160 | `--label-max-width` | Truncates past it |
| Media | `size-100 · size-125 · size-150 · size-200 · size-250 · size-300` | `--image-xxs … -xl` | Avatar, Tile, logo; profile 96 · 128 |
| Field width | 80 · 160 · 240 · 320 · 480 | `--field-width-xs … -xl` | Fields fill their column by default |
| Field min height | 80 · 120 | `--field-min-height-sm · -lg` | Text area, rich text |

## Controls side by side

Controls that share a row share a height. Fields (text, search, select) are one family at 32 and 40; buttons are 24, 32 and 48. A row picks its height first, then each control’s size that reaches it.

| Row | Height | Field · Search · Select | Button | Tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Toolbar, Section header rows | `size-200` | compact | default | `size-125` |
| Field with its own button (add, send) | `size-200` | compact | default | — |
| Table row | `size-250` | compact when editing | compact 24 | `size-125` |
| Form | 40 per field | default | footer default 32 | — |

### Toolbar: 32 throughout

### Field with its own button: 32

### Table rows: compact 24 actions, 20 tags

Each row draws one rule along its bottom edge, inside its 40; the head row’s rule is stronger. The last row drops its rule when the table sits in a frame, so the frame’s edge is never doubled.

### Tags in a field: 20, inside 40 and 32 fields

## Building a control

Height first, then pad. A Button is a 20 line plus 6 above and below, with 12 at each side. A Tag is a 16 line plus 2 above and below, with 4 at each side: 20. A fine primitive exists so the height lands on the grid.

## Do and don’t

### Land every height on 4 px

Do: A 32 Button: on the grid.
Don't: A 22 label: off the grid.

### Pick a core size first

Do: A 40 avatar.
Don't: A 36 avatar no component ships.

### One height per row

Do: Search, Select and buttons at 32.
Don't: 40, 32 and 24 in one toolbar.

## Accessibility

- A control is never smaller than 24 × 24, the minimum pointer target; 32 or more outside a table row or inline toolbar.
- Sizes are rem, so they follow the reader’s font setting.
- A tag is never the only way to act: a removable tag’s remove button has a name.
